biggest_catch: The friend must complete a $400/month direct deposit within 60 days, and the reward is deposited only to the referrer's savings account.
catches: Referral reward of $100 paid to the member's Prestige Community Credit Union savings account when the friend opens a new Rewards or Payback Checking account with a minimum $400/month direct deposit within 60 days.
Additional $100 loan reward if the friend opens a new Prestige loan within 60 days of beginning membership; minimum loan $10,000.
All parties must be at least 18; member must be in good standing; employees, officials, and their immediate families are not eligible.
Referred person must meet credit union membership and loan eligibility requirements.
Conversion accounts do not qualify; not valid with any other offer.
Referral reward may be subject to income tax reporting.
Offer expires at the discretion of the Board of Directors.
Tax treatment not stated on the page (income tax reporting mentioned).
